digest.component_or_area: snapshot entry storage and ticket cache system
propositions: Snapshot entries documented as immutable are mutated by every show_ticket read which writes .cache.json inside the entry directory
reverify_entry baseline digests become stale after reads add .cache.json files, causing entries to fail reverify and be evicted
Hardlink blob-sharing between adjacent entries is unsafe if atomic_write ever switches from os.replace to in-place write, silently corrupting shared inodes
write_cache must not write .cache.json when tracker root is a pinned snapshot; reducer cache should be skipped or redirected outside the entry for snapshot reads
Test coverage must verify atomic_write publishes via os.replace rename semantics, not in-place writes
ADR 0005 immutability claim must be enforced via structural guards or amended to describe actual reader-side immutability contract
